crossRefs.note: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I…
“Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in…
The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it…
I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer.…
It has come to pass that, as he called, and they refused to listen, so they will call, and I will not listen,” said…

translations.web: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
translations.bsb: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer
translations.asv: And thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
